location_description: Overland Park (OH-vər-lend PARK) is the second-most populous city in the U.S. state of Kansas and most populous suburb of Kansas City, Missouri. Located in Johnson County, Kansas, it is one of four principal cities in the Kansas City metropolitan area. As of the 2020 census, the population of the city was 197,238.
